Package models.academic

Class DiplomaProject

java.lang.Object
models.academic.DiplomaProject
All Implemented Interfaces:
Serializable
public class DiplomaProject extends Object implements Serializable
Represents a diploma project (thesis) for a graduate student (Master or PhD). Graduated students must have a list of published research papers as diploma projects. The project is supervised by a Researcher whose h-index must be >= 3.
